purpose: Create a sorted denylist of hashes for canonical E1 neighborhood IDs only, for later v0.8P-v02 collision checking.

source.canonical_identity_semantics: The sealed producer emits neighborhood_id from the canonical anchor/neighborhood identity. It does not emit world_id or root_id; the denylist scope is exactly canonical neighborhood IDs.

extractor.other_json_values: Skipped as opaque bytes; not decoded, retained, emitted, or used.

identity_hash.canonicalization: Decode the one JSON string as strict UTF-8; hash its exact decoded scalar value without trimming, case folding, or Unicode normalization.

output.format: sorted unique JSONL; one lowercase identity_sha256 field per row
output.p_collision_rule: Hash each P-v02 canonical neighborhood ID with this exact algorithm and compare membership. Future reports may expose P-side collision counts/IDs only, never raw E1 identity metadata.

forbidden: candidate joins, candidate features, candidate identities, or candidate order mappings
E1 raw targets or target distributions
predictions, metrics, treatment outcomes, geometry diagnostics, or head outputs
panel generation, LFM loading, feature extraction, training, or evaluation
